reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: South Carolina
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: "Is it specified what remedies are available to a tenant who is unlawfully evicted?"
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic helpers (standalone; no external modules)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

max_number(A, B, A) :-
    number(A),
    number(B),
    A >= B,
    !.
max_number(_A, B, B) :-
    !.

nonempty_list([_|_]) :- !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Encoded statute: SC Code  27-40-660 (2021)
%%
%% Summary (as rules):
%% If landlord unlawfully removes/excludes tenant OR willfully diminishes services
%% by interrupting essential services, then tenant may:
%%  - recover possession OR terminate rental agreement; and in either case,
%%  - recover greater of (3 months' periodic rent) OR (2x actual damages),
%%  - plus reasonable attorney's fees,
%%  - and if rental agreement terminated, landlord must return security recoverable
%%    under  27-40-410.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Statute in force (history indicates enacted 1986; used here for 2021).
statute_in_force(sc_27_40_660, south_carolina, Year) :-
    number(Year),
    Year >= 1986,
    !.

% Conditions for "unlawfully removes or excludes" OR "wilfully diminishes services ... essential services".
statute_sc_27_40_660_trigger(unlawful_remove_or_exclude(Landlord, Tenant, Premises)) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    unlawful_remove_or_exclude(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    !.
statute_sc_27_40_660_trigger(wilful_essential_services_interruption(Landlord, Tenant, Premises)) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    wilful_essential_services_interruption(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    !.

% Compute the statutory monetary award:
% greater of (3 months periodic rent) or (2x actual damages).
statute_sc_27_40_660_monetary_award(RentalAgreement, Tenant, Award) :-
    rental_agreement(RentalAgreement, _Landlord, Tenant),
    periodic_rent(RentalAgreement, PeriodicRent),
    actual_damages(Tenant, ActualDamages),
    ThreeMonths is 3 * PeriodicRent,
    TwiceDamages is 2 * ActualDamages,
    max_number(ThreeMonths, TwiceDamages, Award),
    !.

% Remedy options specified by the statute (possession or termination).
statute_sc_27_40_660_tenant_options([recover_possession, terminate_rental_agreement]) :-
    !.

% Full remedies list available under the statute when triggered.
% Note: we include both options because the statute says the tenant "may" choose.
statute_sc_27_40_660_remedies(State, Year, RentalAgreement, Landlord, Tenant, Premises, Remedies) :-
    statute_in_force(sc_27_40_660, State, Year),
    State = south_carolina,
    rental_agreement(RentalAgreement, Landlord, Tenant),
    (   statute_sc_27_40_660_trigger(unlawful_remove_or_exclude(Landlord, Tenant, Premises))
    ;   statute_sc_27_40_660_trigger(wilful_essential_services_interruption(Landlord, Tenant, Premises))
    ),
    statute_sc_27_40_660_tenant_options(Options),
    statute_sc_27_40_660_monetary_award(RentalAgreement, Tenant, Award),
    Remedies = [
        options(Options),
        monetary_award(greater_of(three_months_rent, twice_actual_damages), Award),
        attorneys_fees(reasonable),
        security_return_if_terminated(returns_security_recoverable_under_sc_27_40_410)
    ],
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encoding the question's factual statement)
%%
%% Statement to encode: "tenant who is unlawfully evicted"
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Jurisdiction and time for the question.
scenario_jurisdiction(south_carolina, 2021) :- !.

% Parties and premises.
landlord(l1) :- !.
tenant(t1) :- !.
premises(p1) :- !.

% Rental agreement and relevant money facts (to allow statute computation).
rental_agreement(ra1, l1, t1) :- !.
periodic_rent(ra1, 1000) :- !.          % periodic rent amount (e.g., monthly)
actual_damages(t1, 800) :- !.           % actual damages sustained by tenant

% Core "unlawful eviction" fact: landlord unlawfully removes/excludes tenant.
unlawful_remove_or_exclude(l1, t1, p1) :- !.

% Alternative trigger not used in this scenario (kept defined to avoid undefined predicates).
wilful_essential_services_interruption(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Premises) :-
    fail.

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario statement is satisfied.
% Here, "unlawfully evicted" is represented as "unlawful_remove_or_exclude".
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_jurisdiction(_State, _Year),
    landlord(l1),
    tenant(t1),
    premises(p1),
    rental_agreement(ra1, l1, t1),
    unlawful_remove_or_exclude(l1, t1, p1),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning for the question asked
%%
%% "Is it specified what remedies are available to a tenant who is unlawfully evicted?"
%% => yes if, under the scenario, the statute yields a non-empty remedies set.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

remedies_specified_for_scenario :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_jurisdiction(State, Year),
    statute_sc_27_40_660_remedies(State, Year, ra1, l1, t1, p1, Remedies),
    nonempty_list(Remedies),
    !.

housing_answer(yes) :-
    remedies_specified_for_scenario,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it specified what remedies are available to a tenant who is unlawfully evicted?
